variants.headline: Building finished and handed over
variants.sub: The project {project} has been completed and handed over by {builder}.
variants.body:
The builder {builder} has finished and handed over {project}. It opens next month. The distinction between handover and opening matters to an assessment of {target}: a building has been delivered, while its entry into use is the following stage rather than an event already accomplished by this notice.

The gazette records construction and handover as completed. The opening is a subsequent stage, and the notice should preserve the difference between those events. Administrative clarity requires neither withholding recognition of delivery nor enlarging it into an account of operations that have not yet begun under this report.

We welcome {target} in this assessment. A building actually completed and handed over deserves practical credit, without requiring us to pretend that its future use has already answered every question about performance. Care in the public record is part of responsible administration.
